# TASK-004 Spec Context

- Context-SHA256: `4efcf9c2f5437f01fdc960761113265396e468f3031567b8d4790f57a7d7f314`

## Required Rules
- `backend-code-quality-performance#RULE-backend-write-err-001`: HTTP 错误响应必须走 `writeErr` / `writeRuntimeFailure` / `writeRepoError` 且只传 `errcode` 常量；禁止旧签名 `writeErr(w, r, status, code, msg)` 或传字符串 message。
  - rule_sha256=e477dfd2db892a5bc6004823b5fa65c3a6813ae70df9b8b6d0eca5d3a725102d verifier=backend-code-quality-performance#RULE-backend-write-err-001; artifacts=session-cancel.backend.design.md,session-cancel.md
- `backend-logging#RULE-backend-logging-001`: Logs and audit records must be structured enough to debug, must never include secrets/credentials, and must keep operation audit separate from skill-execution telemetry.
  - rule_sha256=66df1eb1fb216358fe95f5c2e07a4f0d589a3d34cfab99924dd3a850e75b2ee3 verifier=backend-logging#RULE-backend-logging-001; artifacts=session-cancel.backend.design.md,session-cancel.md
- `backend-logging#RULE-backend-redact-001`: Error strings written to logs, audit details, apply-failure fields, or user-visible diagnostics that may embed internal context must pass `auditlog.RedactDiagnostic` (or equivalent redaction) before persistence or emission.
  - rule_sha256=ed1b22a3697079e92a7a6cfe8cee467fec53e3529d5fab3b66677a19eb3b6bf8 verifier=backend-logging#RULE-backend-redact-001; artifacts=session-cancel.backend.design.md,session-cancel.md
- `backend-platform-rules#RULE-backend-platform-001`: Control-plane changes must preserve multi-user isolation, mandatory model-pool binding, secret-not-in-image injection, and generation-based runtime apply with health/rollback semantics.
  - rule_sha256=1132efbe981923b9f606fb135dbf8ec4e4b220ef74b775d6a140207674eb0749 verifier=backend-platform-rules#RULE-backend-platform-001; artifacts=session-cancel.backend.design.md,session-cancel.md
- `backend-platform-rules#RULE-backend-http-envelope-001`: All Console HTTP handlers must emit responses via `writeJSON` / `writeErr` with stable `code*` constants; do not call `json.NewEncoder` (or ad-hoc maps) in handlers.
  - rule_sha256=15cb5de807ea6faa91cc37f651b0fe3996e96e769466a75fae1a5a7041954ab7 verifier=backend-platform-rules#RULE-backend-http-envelope-001; artifacts=session-cancel.backend.design.md,session-cancel.md
- `backend-platform-rules#RULE-backend-model-pool-001`: Creating a Human User requires binding an unbound `model_config_id`; already-bound models must fail with a conflict (`ErrLLMModelAlreadyBound` / API conflict). No implicit shared or override model fallback chain.
  - rule_sha256=23c293f00680e409de4b6c712152fa0bc9e812273399c72c135ccdaf9082ee9f verifier=backend-platform-rules#RULE-backend-model-pool-001; artifacts=session-cancel.backend.design.md,session-cancel.md
